newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down one cent to 13.77 cents/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down one cent to 13.77 cents/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell one cent to close at 13.77 ringgit ($5.48) a kg on Thursday despite a higher overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There were a lot of initial offers at the start and bids only came in at the lower level," said a trader.
He said the market was still trying to test the 14 ringgit level. "The market is fundamentally strong but it's virtually dictated by the LME."
